profile.headline: Recent Full-Stack Developer Graduate from Hackbright Academy - looking for entry level Developer roles!
profile.summary:
Passionate Logistics/Office/Data Entry Professional looking for remote opportunities.
Experienced with:
•	Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Word, Power Point)
•	SAP/Accounts Receivable
•	Google Suite (Google Docs, Sheets, Hangout)
•	Video Conferencing Platforms (Zoom, Discord, Skype, Google Hangouts, Twitch)
•	Social Media (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Tumblr)
•	Team Chat Platforms (Slack, Discord)
•	Proprietary Software (Insurance, Logistics)
•	Hardware Diagnosis/Troubleshooting 
•	Software Troubleshoot
Interested parties can email me at avt999@gmail.com

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Experience with coding projects in Java, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, PostgreSQL
•	Creating the following projects:
O	Web Form Application in Java Spring Boot
O	Text-Based JavaScript Video Game
O	Tabletop automated desktop applications – C++

positions.title: Freelance Computer Technician
positions.description: Freelance work building custom computers, arcade machines, and troubleshooting hardware/software.

positions.title: Data & Logistics Clerk
positions.description:
•	Handled shipping logistics for a laboratory company including leading Q/A efforts for all shipments and packages from the lab.
•	Creating documentation, shipping labels, and improving logistic processes. 
•	In charge of data entry for shipment data, creating shipping entries, and updating sales website with on-hand inventory. 
•	Responsible for all Q/A efforts in sales systems for duplicate errors. 
•	Working with customers to receive ISO verification.
positions.insights: Skills: Software · Data Entry · Microsoft Office · General Office Skills · Logistics Management · Data Quality Control · Export Documentation

positions.title: Sea Logistics Operational Care Specialist
positions.description: Handled sea logistics for exports for multiple branches across the United States. Created documents and provided them to the customers and steamship lines for cargo pickup and sailing, respectively. Acted as the liaison between the customer service representatives and the steamship lines to ensure shipments were not delayed. Certified to handle hazmat cargo.
positions.insights: Skills: Software · Data Entry · Export · Microsoft Office · General Office Skills · Middle Office Operations

positions.title: Claim Support Assistant I
positions.description: Promoted to Insurance Verification Team; assisted auto physical damage adjusters in updating claims from police reports, filing claims/gathering claim info from other insurance carriers, made outbound calls to claimant insurance carriers/drivers/owners to verify insurance, and sending document proof to other insurance carriers.

positions.title: Claim Support Staff
positions.description: Assigned to the Claim Support Operations (CSO) unit; assisted in processing invoices, training other employees, data entry work for claims, utilizing multiple AAA software/platforms, and working    special projects. Participated in a company-wide pilot to raise cyber security awareness. Entering invoices into SAP. Accounts Receivable.

positions.title: File Clerk
positions.description:
Worked individually, and with a partner, to process boxes and claim files. Performed data entry. Lifting claim boxes of varied weight and transporting them to work station and to delivery station.
•	Interpreted project claim files to determine correct lines of businesses and destruction dates.
•	Performed quality control on boxes and claim files to ensure standards.
•	Utilized Microsoft Office Suites to perform data entry

positions.title: Music Teacher
positions.description:
Entrusted to manage and facilitate large groups of children and teens while teaching students to play a traditional Hmong instrument. Built relationships with student, parents, staff and community members.
•	Taught the qeej instrument to students; Led rehearsals; Performed at parades, funerals and events.
•	Taught students about Hmong history and culture through musical education.
•	Coordinated performances with organizations and events around the Twin Cities in Minnesota.
•	Assisted in office duties such as phone calls, filing, and data entry.

educations.fieldOfStudy: College/University Preparatory and Advanced High School/Secondary Diploma Program
